supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s partition the number line to locate unit fractions. Required Preparation CCSS Standards Addressing 3.NF.A.2 3.NF.A.2.a Lesson Timeline Warm-up 10 min Activity 1 15 min Activity 2 20 min Lesson Synthesis 10 min Cool-down 5 min Teacher Reflectio
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Partition the interval from 0 to 1 and locate unit fractions within that interval.
teachingSteps: Choose the whole interval from zero to one.
Partition it into equal intervals according to the denominator.
Count intervals from zero to locate and name the numerator position.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.caution: Intervals must be equal; tick count is not the same as interval count from zero.
